deities: Goddess Renuka (Renukaji; wife of sage Jamadagni and mother of Parashurama, sixth avatar of Vishnu; regarded as an incarnation of Durga)
Lord Parashurama (son of Renuka; small shrine/parashurama tal at the base of the lake)
festivals: Annual Renuka Ji Fair - held every November (Prabodhini Ekadashi), celebrating the sacred reunion of Goddess Renuka and her son Parashurama; a state-level fair drawing pilgrims from across India

history.period: DATE CONFLICT: one source says built in the 18th century by Raja Ram Singh of Sirmaur; another says the temple was built overnight by Gurkhas in the early 19th century; a third says early 19th century (verify - no single date confirmed)
history.summary: The Renuka Ji Temple is the principal pilgrimage shrine on the banks of Renuka Lake in Sirmaur district, Himachal Pradesh, dedicated to Goddess Renuka - wife of sage Jamadagni and mother of Parashurama, one of Vishnu's avatars. Puranic and local legend hold that Renuka jumped into the lake to escape the demon-emperor Sahasrarjuna (Sahasrarjun), who had killed her husband; the lake is therefore worshipped as the goddess's embodiment, and a smaller pool at the lake's base personifies Parashurama, who wished to stay at his mother's feet forever. The site is also linked to the Mahabharata and Puranas. DATE CONFLICT (verify): templeyatri says Raja Ram Singh of Sirmaur built it in the 18th century; Curly Tales says the original temple was built overnight by an invading Gurkha force in the early 19th century; onefivenine says early 19th century. The lake (Ramsar wetland, largest natural lake in Himachal) sits at ~660 m within the Renuka Wildlife Sanctuary, with a Renuka Zoo nearby. The annual Renuka Fair in November (Prabodhini Ekadashi) celebrates the mother-son reunion. TIMING CONFLICT: one vlog source gives darshan 9:00 AM-5:00 PM, aarti at 5:00 AM and 6:00 PM, and temple open 6:00 AM-10:00 PM - internally inconsistent, verify locally. CSV STATE FLAG: the CSV 'state' column wrongly holds the district name ('Sirmaur') - the real state is HIMACHAL PRADESH.

name: Renuka Ji Temple
town_description: Renuka is a small pilgrim settlement in Sirmaur district, Himachal Pradesh, on the banks of Renuka Lake at about 660 m, inside the Renuka Wildlife Sanctuary (Ramsar wetland) and reserve forest, roughly 38 km from Nahan and 130 km from Chandigarh. The lake - the largest natural lake in Himachal Pradesh - is itself the sacred tank of the temple, and the annual November fair makes it one of the state's most important pilgrimage gatherings.
tradition: Hinduism (Shaktism; Renuka regarded as an incarnation of Goddess Durga)

travel.road: Renuka is about 3 hours by road from Chandigarh (Chandigarh-Panchkula-Barwala-Nahan-Dadahu-Renuka route); also reachable from Nahan (about 38 km) and Paonta Sahib (verify distances).
